title: 停顿、填充语与自我修正
goal: 用简短表达组织思路、修正局部信息，并保持回答内容连续。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 用合适的表达自我修正
用合适的表达争取思考时间

body.p: 流利的回答可以有短暂的思考和局部修正。We met on Tuesday—I mean, Thursday. 只修正日期，不重说整段。修正后接着说与问题相关的内容。
填充语本身不是答案。Let me think. I chose the morning shift because it ended before class. 先用一句组织思路，再给出实际内容。反复说 Let me think 而不回答，信息没有推进。

cards.title: 思考时间的表达
rows: Let me think.
用来组织内容，后面紧接答案，只说一次。
Let me think. The hardest part was assigning roles.
That's a good question.
回应提问，留出思考时间，后面要给出立场。
That's a good question. I'd keep the smaller groups.
Well, …
用在回答开头，不在每个短语前都加。
Well, I chose the earlier session because it fit my schedule.
完整信息之后
说完一项信息再停顿，想下一项。
I handled registration. The next task was checking badges.
先给明确部分
先说已确定的答案，再挑细节。
I preferred the trial session. One useful feature was the feedback.
缺少精确例子
想不起具体例子时说一般理由，不编造经历。
I don't recall a specific occasion, but the schedule usually helped me plan.
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定

cards.title: 局部自我修正
rows: I mean, …
替换口误，以后面说的为准。
I took the evening class—I mean, the afternoon class.
or rather, …
换成更准确的说法，主要意思不变。
I organized the event, or rather, I handled registration.
Let me rephrase that.
整句说不下去时，换一个简单的完整句。
Let me rephrase that. Sharing the job reduced waiting.
修正数量
用正确的数字替换错的数字，然后接着说。
We needed fifteen—I mean, fifty copies.
修正语法
改正出错的词，接着说完原句。
She work—she works at the information desk.
澄清范围
把过强的判断改准确。
Everyone agreed—or rather, most members agreed.
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定

cards.title: 停顿与内容连续性
rows: 偶尔填充语
后面接着说相关内容，可以帮助组织回答。
Well, the main advantage was easier access.
填充语过多
删掉重复的填充语，保留理由和细节。
Well, well, it was, well, useful. → It saved us a trip.
长时间沉默
选一个明确的要点，用简单句接着说。
The main difficulty was finding a suitable time.
句子中途放弃
不停在没说完的从句上，换一种说法说完。
What made it difficult was … → Let me rephrase that. The times conflicted.
连续道歉
直接改正错误，不连续道歉。
Tuesday, sorry, sorry … → Tuesday—I mean, Thursday.
无法回忆细节
先说明记不清，再说能确定的内容，不编造细节。
I don't remember the exact date, but it was during orientation.
cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定

body.box:
Question: What was the speaker's role in the public reading?
Response: Let me think. I wrote the introduction—or rather, I revised an introduction the organizer had drafted. I shortened it so the reading could begin on time.

What role does the speaker finally claim?
1. Drafting the entire introduction independently
2. Reading the introduction at the event
3. Revising an existing introduction
4. Organizing the full public reading

body.p: 第三项正确。or rather 把 wrote 缩小为 revised an introduction the organizer had drafted。Let me think 只用来组织答案，后面紧接角色、具体动作和目的。
修正只改了一处，话题不变，也没有重讲活动背景。revised 取代了 wrote，二者不是两项职责。

groups.text: We met in the north wing—I mean, the west wing—because that room had the larger screen.

items.stem: Which location remains after the correction?
options: The west wing with the smaller screen
The west wing with the larger screen
Both wings during the same meeting
The north wing, which had the larger screen
items.why: I mean 后面的 the west wing 替换了 the north wing。because 从句说的是这个房间的屏幕较大，即第二项。

groups.text: I trained all the volunteers, or rather, I trained the volunteers assigned to the ticket desk.

options: It changes the activity from training to selling tickets.
It adds a second training group outside the event.
It narrows the group that the speaker trained.
It withdraws the claim that any training occurred.
items.why: or rather 后面的 the volunteers assigned to the ticket desk 缩小了 all the volunteers 的范围，trained 不变，即第三项。

groups.text: The speaker says: 'The meeting was on Friday.' The actual day was Monday; the meeting topic remains unchanged.

items.stem: Which continuation makes the local correction?
options: I mean, Monday. We discussed the same proposal.
Friday and Monday were both meeting days.
Monday was the deadline, not the meeting day.
The proposal changed, though Friday was correct.
items.why: 实际日期是 Monday，所以用 I mean 把 Friday 换成 Monday，话题不变，即第一项。

groups.text: I designed the whole survey—let me rephrase that. I wrote the questions about transport, while another member wrote the housing questions.

items.stem: What should the final account retain?
options: The speaker designed every part of the survey.
Another member wrote the transport questions.
The speaker withdrew from designing the survey.
The speaker wrote only the transport section.
items.why: let me rephrase that 之后，说话人只写了 transport 部分，housing 部分由另一人写。第四项保留了这一修正。

groups.text: Question: What made the first tutoring session difficult? Candidate opening: 'Let me think.' Notes: the learners had different levels; the room was new; the session lasted an hour.

items.stem: Which continuation supplies the requested content?
options: Let me think again about the first session.
Each learner needed a different level of help.
The session lasted an hour in a new room.
That's a good question about the first tutoring session.
items.why: 问题问的是困难。notes 里的 the learners had different levels 就是困难，第二项把它说了出来。

groups.text: Question: Which part of the club trip was most useful? Response: 'That's a good question. Well, that's a good question. Let me think.'

items.stem: Which weakness is established by the words?
options: The speaker chose an unsuitable part of the trip.
The speaker corrected the trip destination.
The speaker has not named any useful part.
The speaker gave too many examples of usefulness.
items.why: 三句话都是填充语，没有回答 Which part，即第三项。

groups.text: A speaker cannot remember the exact date of a skills workshop but remembers learning to check bicycle brakes.

items.stem: Which continuation acknowledges the gap and resumes relevant content?
options: I don't recall the date, but I learned to check brakes.
I remember the exact date, but not what I learned.
I don't recall the date, so I can't say much more.
Let me think about the date; let me think about it again.
items.why: 说话人记不清日期，但记得学过检查刹车。第一项先承认记不清，再接上记得的内容。

groups.text: The speaker stops after: 'What made the timetable difficult was the way in which the classes...' The intended point is that two required classes overlapped.

items.stem: Which continuation completes the intended idea?
options: What made the timetable difficult was the way the classes...
Let me rephrase. Two optional classes overlapped.
Let me think, well, let me think about classes.
Let me rephrase that. Two required classes overlapped.
items.why: 要说的是两门必修课时间冲突。第四项用一个完整的简单句说出这一点；第一项仍停在没说完的从句上。

lines.text: I booked the recording room for Wednesday—I mean, Thursday. Wednesday was when I submitted the request.

items.stem: What is the booking day after the self-correction?
options: Thursday, while Wednesday was the request day
Wednesday, while Thursday was the request day
Both days, because two bookings were submitted
Neither day, because the request was withdrawn
items.why: I mean, Thursday 把预订日改为 Thursday。Wednesday was when I submitted the request 说明 Wednesday 是申请日，即第一项。

lines.text: I managed the whole exhibition, or rather, I arranged the labels for the photographs. Other members handled the lighting and invitations.

options: It adds lighting to the speaker's responsibilities.
It narrows the speaker's role to arranging labels.
It replaces photographs with a different exhibition.
It transfers invitations from others to the speaker.
items.why: or rather 后面的 I arranged the labels 缩小了 managed the whole exhibition 的范围，即第二项。

lines.text: Let me think. The most difficult part of the canoe trip was keeping the group together. We agreed on meeting points so nobody had to guess where to stop.

items.stem: What makes the opening serve a useful purpose?
options: It corrects the location of the meeting points.
It replaces the answer with praise for the question.
It briefly introduces a specific difficulty and response.
It repeats the trip question without giving any difficulty.
items.why: Let me think 之后紧接困难 keeping the group together 和办法 meeting points，即第三项。

lines.text: That's a good question. I would choose the quieter volunteer shift because it gives me time to explain the forms to new arrivals.

items.stem: What follows the initial thinking phrase?
options: A correction of the volunteer shift's starting time
A repeated request to ask the same question
An abandoned sentence about new arrivals
A clear choice supported by a specific reason
items.why: 填充语之后是 I would choose the quieter volunteer shift because …，有选择也有理由，即第四项。

groups.text: The speaker intends to say that most workshop participants completed a model. The speaker begins: 'Every participant completed a model.'

items.stem: Which repair preserves the intended scope?
options: Or rather, most participants completed one.
Or rather, no participants completed one.
I mean, every participant made several models.
I mean, the models were completed before the workshop.
items.why: 要说的是 most participants，所以用 Or rather 把 Every 缩小为 most，即第一项。

groups.text: The speaker first says 'I invented the fundraising game.' Notes show that the game already existed; the speaker adapted its rules for a smaller group.

items.stem: Which local correction accurately states the contribution?
options: I mean, I invented the group that played it.
Or rather, I adapted an existing game's rules.
Or rather, I used the existing rules without changes.
I mean, I adapted the game for a much larger group.
items.why: notes 说 the game already existed，说话人 adapted its rules for a smaller group，第二项与之对应。

groups.text: Question: Why did the speaker prefer the weekend shift? Written transcript: 'Well, well, I, well, preferred it because, well, it left weekdays free for classes.'

items.stem: Which revision removes repeated fillers while retaining the reason?
options: I preferred weekdays because weekend classes kept me busy.
Well, well, the weekend shift was a shift I preferred.
I preferred it because I could attend classes on weekdays.
I preferred it, well, because I preferred the weekend shift.
items.why: 理由是 it left weekdays free for classes。第三项删去了 well，并把理由改写为 could attend classes on weekdays。

groups.text: A speaker has fallen silent while explaining a lost reservation. The known facts are that the confirmation email went to an old address and the booking was later recovered.

items.stem: Which restart uses those facts to resume a complete answer?
options: The reservation, the email, the old address, the recovered booking...
Let me think. The email reached my current address, but the booking was lost for good.
Let me put it simply. The email went to an old address, so the booking was lost for good.
Let me put it simply. The email went to an old address, but we recovered the booking.
items.why: 已知事实是邮件发到了旧地址，预订后来找回了。第四项用完整的句子说出这两点；第三项说预订没找回，与事实相反。
